footer_component.description: The intentional way to manage your recurring expenses. Built for those who value clarity over convenience.

hero_component.description: Recurio shows you what recurring costs actually do over time. No aggressive budgeting - just clear numbers that reveal how small monthly decisions quietly compound.
hero_component.tip: Tip: Click a subscription to see how it impacts your monthly / yearly burn.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.quote: “We are living in an era of ‘Subscription Creep’. We trade long-term financial freedom for short-term digital convenience, 10 € at a time.”

features_component.intro: Recurio is built around a simple idea: you can’t make good financial decisions if you never see the full picture.

cost_normalization.title: Cost Normalization
cost_normalization.description: We struggle to compare a 12 €/mo app with a 120 €/year service. Recurio translates every subscription into a single, normalized "Burn Rate," exposing the true weight of your digital footprint.

time_awareness.title: Time Awareness
time_awareness.description: Renewals don’t surprise you — because you see them coming. Track upcoming charges across 7 and 14-day windows and stay ahead of every renewal.

manual_entry.title: Manual Entry
manual_entry.description: Intentionality starts with data entry. By manually adding subs, you confront the cost before the charge happens.

privacy.title: Privacy by Architecture.
privacy.description: Your financial footprint is processed and stored exclusively within your browser's secure environment—never on our servers. We don't just protect your data; we ensure we never have custody of it in the first place.

data_visualization_component.heading: The cost of "Just one more."

description.part_1: A 15 €/month subscription isn’t just 15 €. It’s 1,800 € over ten years. When you see the numbers stretched across time, "small" choices reveal their true

behavioral.transactionAutonomy: Out of {totalEvents} payment operations processed, {autoEventsCount} ({autoEventRatio}%) were initialized on fully autonomous API lines, while the remaining represent manual renewal adjustments.

anomalies.inactiveAccountDrift: Inactive account drift: Ghost accounts quietly drawing capital.
anomalies.uncappedUtilityChecks: Uncapped utility checks: Automated warnings identifying high-cost unmapped software items.
anomalies.pausedServiceLeakage: Paused service leakage: Automated system scans to ensure paused subscriptions stop executing transactions.
anomalies.secureWaste: Secure: No post-cancel charges or uncategorized leak vectors detected.
anomalies.lumpSumRenewals: Lump-sum renewals: Visual highlights identifying upcoming large-value yearly platform renewals.
anomalies.gracePeriodExpirations: Grace period expirations: System safeguards to prevent manual payment plans from unexpected shutdowns.

registry.empty: No subscription data recorded. Build your registry inside the dashboard to initialize tracking tables.

history.empty: No transaction history logged. Charges will populate as recurring billing processes.

portfolioDiversity.highlyDiversified: Your portfolio is highly diversified across {count} distinct categories, which minimizes localized dependency but increases vendor overhead.
portfolioDiversity.moderatelyBalanced: Your spending footprint is moderately balanced across {count} focus categories, indicating a stable, highly specialized tech stack.
portfolioDiversity.highlyConcentrated: Your expenses are highly concentrated in only {count} categories. This indicates targeted software utility but makes your cash flow vulnerable to pricing changes in these specific markets.

executiveSummary.noSubs: Our diagnostic scan shows that you currently have zero active subscriptions logged in your ledger. If you are using digital tools, registering them inside Recurio will unlock critical metrics like projected burn-rates, auto-renew buffers, and potential expense waste alerts.
executiveSummary.heavyLeakage: Recurio's audit engines have flagged a heavy leakage profile in your portfolio. You currently maintain {activeCount} active subscriptions costing {monthlyBurn}/mo, but our scan identified {warningCount} critical warnings. These include potentially active charges on paused services, and pending lump-sum renewals. Optimizing these entries in Section VI is highly recommended to protect cash flow.
executiveSummary.highSpend: Your digital software investment footprint is high but structurally sound. With an average item cost of {avgCost}, you maintain healthy baseline control. Recurio detected {warningCount} moderate operational risk factors. The ledger has high automated maintenance, meaning passive subscription creep remains your main financial threat vector.
executiveSummary.optimized: Your active services profile is highly optimized, demonstrating strong fiscal discipline. You hold a tight stack of {activeCount} active subscriptions with a monthly burn rate of {monthlyBurn}. Only {warningCount} low-priority warning flags were raised, confirming that your recurring overhead is well-protected from leakage.

financialHealth.noSubs: When subscriptions are registered in Recurio, this section evaluates your monthly recurring drain and projects your yearly cost. This baseline calculation tracks the balance of flexible monthly agreements alongside discounted yearly plans to help you allocate cash buffers.
financialHealth.annualHeavy: A prominent concentration of Yearly billing cycles ({annualRatio}% of your subscriptions) points to deep long-term savings but exposes your capital to sudden, massive 'lump-sum' depletions. We recommend retaining a cash reserve equivalent to your top yearly obligations.
financialHealth.monthlyHeavy: Your recurring ledger is dominated by Monthly cycles. This provides you with excellent agility and low cancelation overhead, but exposes you to 'death by a thousand cuts'. These small, creeping monthly hits are easy to lose track of over time.
financialHealth.balanced: You are maintaining a balanced hybrid strategy. By mixing flexible monthly agreements with discounted yearly plans, you keep immediate cash flow liquid while capitalizing on long-term platform savings where appropriate.

behavioral.noSubs: This diagnostic panel evaluates platform automation behaviors when active subscriptions are recorded. Recurio measures your automation dependency—calculating set-and-forget billing loops against manual payment controls—to prevent passive payment drift.
behavioral.highAutomation: Your automation dependency is exceptionally high ({autoRenewRatio}%). This set-and-forget approach minimizes cognitive load but drastically increases exposure to 'ghost billing'—where deprecated features or unused user accounts quietly drain resources for months.
behavioral.lowAutomation: Your automation dependency is very low ({autoRenewRatio}%). Most of your plans require manual intervention. While this ensures perfect control over your payments, it heavily increases your administrative overhead and creates high disruption risk if a manual billing window is missed.
behavioral.balanced: Your balanced auto-renew profile ({autoRenewRatio}% automatic) represents the optimal security sweet-spot. Core utilities remain continuously automated, while peripheral project accounts are kept on manual leashes, blocking surprise charges.

lifecycle.noSubs: Our tracking engine evaluates transactional pricing stability across your history once logged. Recurio monitors consistency over successive cycles to automatically flag unannounced vendor hikes or usage-based tier shifts.
lifecycle.variablePricing: We identified {count} service plans that exhibit price volatility (variable pricing models). These variable structures usually point to consumption-based fees. We recommend auditing these plans inside your payment methods to avoid unexpected cash-draw shocks.
lifecycle.stablePricing: Our metrics show a perfectly stable fixed-rate structure across your entire logged history. No variable charge deviations were found, making your recurring monthly spending highly predictable and easy to model.

intro.p1: This Privacy Policy describes how Recurio (“we”, “us”, “our”) collects, processes, stores, shares, and protects personal data when you access or use our web application, services, and related features (collectively, the “Service”).
intro.p2: This document is designed to comply with applicable data protection regulations, including but not limited to the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”), the UK GDPR, the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the CPRA (“CCPA/CPRA”), and other applicable privacy laws depending on your jurisdiction.
intro.p3: By using the Service, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

data_controller.title: 1. Data Controller and Contact Information
data_controller.p1: For the purposes of GDPR and similar regulations, the data controller responsible for your personal data is Recurio.
data_controller.p2: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data, you may contact us via the support channel provided within the Service.

categories.title: 2. Categories of Personal Data We Collect
categories.intro: We collect and process several categories of personal data depending on your usage of the Service:

account.title: 2.1 Account and Identity Data
account.desc: When you register or authenticate, we collect identifiers such as email address, user ID, authentication provider identifiers (e.g., Clerk user ID), and optional profile metadata.

subscription.title: 2.2 Subscription and Financial Tracking Data
subscription.desc: The core functionality of Recurio involves user-provided data related to recurring subscriptions. This may include subscription names, billing cycles, renewal dates, prices, categories, and notes. This data is user-generated and stored solely for providing the Service.

technical.title: 2.3 Technical and Device Data
technical.desc: We automatically collect technical data such as IP address, browser type, device identifiers, operating system, language preferences, and access timestamps.

usage.title: 2.4 Usage and Interaction Data
usage.desc: We collect information about how you interact with the Service, including pages visited, feature usage, navigation patterns, and performance metrics.

communication.title: 2.5 Communication Data
communication.desc: If you contact support or interact with us, we may process communication content, metadata, and related correspondence.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
purposes.intro: We process personal data for the following purposes:

items.maintain: To provide and maintain core application functionality.
items.store: To store, display, and manage subscription-related user data.
items.authenticate: To authenticate users and maintain secure sessions.
items.improve: To improve performance, usability, and feature development.
items.secure: To ensure system security, prevent fraud, and detect abuse.
items.comply: To comply with legal obligations and regulatory requirements.

legal_basis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
legal_basis.intro: If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), we process personal data under the following legal bases:

items.contractual: <bold>Contractual necessity:</bold> Processing required to provide the Service.
items.legitimate: <bold>Legitimate interests:</bold> Improving, securing, and maintaining the Service.
items.consent: <bold>Consent:</bold> Where required for optional features such as analytics or marketing communications.
items.legal: <bold>Legal obligation:</bold> Compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

sharing.title: 5. Data Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell personal data. However, we may share data with carefully selected third-party service providers strictly for operational purposes.

items.auth: <bold>5.1 Authentication Providers:</bold> We use third-party authentication services (e.g., Clerk) to manage secure login and identity verification.
items.infra: <bold>5.2 Infrastructure Providers:</bold> Hosting, database storage, and cloud infrastructure providers (e.g., Vercel and database services) may process data on our behalf.
items.analytics: <bold>5.3 Analytics Providers:</bold> If enabled, anonymized or pseudonymized usage data may be processed for analytics and performance monitoring.
items.email: <bold>5.4 Email and Communication Services:</bold> We may use third-party email providers for transactional and service-related communication.

sharing.outro: All third-party processors are contractually obligated to implement appropriate data protection safeguards.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.p1: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy.
retention.p2: Subscription-related data is retained for as long as your account remains active. Upon account deletion, we will permanently delete or anonymize your data within a reasonable timeframe unless retention is required for legal or security purposes.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights:

items.access: Right of access to your personal data.
items.rectification: Right to rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data.
items.erasure: Right to erasure (“right to be forgotten”).
items.withdraw: Right to withdraw consent at any time.

rights.outro: Requests to exercise these rights can be made through the support system within the Service.

security.title: 8. Security Measures
security.p1: We implement industry-standard technical and organizational security measures to protect personal data. These include encryption in transit (HTTPS), access control mechanisms, secure authentication systems, and monitoring for suspicious activity.
security.p2: However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

international.title: 9. International Data Transfers
international.p1: Your data may be transferred and processed outside your country of residence. Where applicable, we ensure appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent mechanisms.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.p1: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain authentication sessions, improve functionality, and analyze usage patterns. You may control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

children.title: 11. Children’s Privacy
children.p1: The Service is not intended for individuals under the age of 16 (or the applicable minimum age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors.

changes.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 13. Contact Information
contact.p1: For any questions, concerns, or requests regarding your personal data, please contact us via the support section of the application.
